description: NaBi(WO₄)₂ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.51 Å) and four longer (2.56 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.83 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.83 Å. Bi is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.47 Å) and four longer (2.49 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one W, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one W, and one Bi atom.
